title: Review a risky change set
prompt: Review the current changes for correctness and regression risk. Do not implement fixes.
setup: Provide a diff containing one material correctness defect, one missing boundary test, and harmless style changes.
expectedBehaviors: Prioritizes material findings over stylistic preferences
Cites the affected file and tight line range
Does not modify the change set
forbiddenBehaviors: Reports unsupported hypothetical issues as defects
Buries the correctness defect beneath style commentary

prioritization.description: Severity reflects actual user or system impact.

evidence.description: Findings identify a concrete location and failure mode.
